correctness.rationale: Even-start length-2n factors are substitution images; at an odd start the leading zero of an aligned image is moved to the end, because the next block also starts with zero. This proves surjectivity on necklaces represented by factors. An even rotation of images respects blocks, and an odd rotation can match two images only if both are all zero, hence both antecedents are all ones. For an independent check of the minimum, the one-count sets at the even and odd starts of length 2j+1 are j minus the length-j count set and j+1 minus the length-(j+1) count set, respectively, by p_(2i)=0, p_(2i+1)=1-p_i. For length three, 000 and 101 give spread at least two; for any larger odd length one of j and j+1 is a smaller odd number at least three, so induction gives spread at least two. Sliding windows attain the intermediate counts. Thus odd lengths greater than one have at least three classes, and the bijection finishes the minimum characterization. Bounded valuation-generation and literal-rotation counts corroborated the result (e.g. c(3)=c(6)=c(12)=3, c(5)=c(10)=c(40)=4).
residual_risks: The finite check is illustrative; at the tested lengths completeness follows from the length-256 block cover with all three legal adjacent pairs 01, 10, 00 represented in the prefix.

evidence: The abelian one-count spread is positive in every positive length by aperiodicity. The first recurrence branch adds one whenever the remainder r>0; the other reflects to a smaller non-power-of-two length. Thus the spread is at least two off powers of two. The cyclic paper gives c(2^k)=2.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Distinct one-counts cannot share a class. The exact minimum iff power of two follows without the frozen scaling law and was already implied by the older results, even though not stated as a cyclic theorem there.

value.rationale: A class-level bijection would be a useful exact invariant for computing ordinary necklace complexity at every even length. Here, however, that exact invariant is already supplied independently in the indexed corpus, while the new-looking exclusion from the minimum follows mechanically from the earlier spread recurrence. The frozen record leaves no demonstrated additional mathematical contribution.
residual_risks: This assesses the record's additional value relative to checked coverage, not who first found the bijection.
